Thanks for the detailed report. I checked `packages/vitest/package.json`. `peerDependencies` and `peerDependenciesMeta` list `@vitest/browser-*` and `@vitest/ui`, but not `@vitest/coverage-v8` or `@vitest/coverage-istanbul`. That matches what you describe. I found no earlier issue about this (searched "coverage-v8 peer dependency" and the error text).

I'm treating this as a packaging change request: declare the coverage providers as optional peers so strict layouts like pnpm can resolve them. I haven't reproduced it under pnpm, and I haven't checked why the providers were left out of the peers. A minimal repro (a repo with pnpm 10, `coverage.provider: 'v8'` and `@vitest/coverage-v8` installed) would help confirm. Your `packageExtensions` workaround looks reasonable until then.

I can't promise a fix or a release.
